title.zh: 承认失误 · 主动向上汇报

description.zh: 把自己造成的线上问题主动说清楚：事实、影响、已做的处置、以及下一步
description.en: Report a mistake you caused: facts, impact, what you already did, what's next

en: name what you've done and what's next

line.text: I saw the incident channel blow up this morning. What happened?
line.translation: 我看到今天早上事故频道炸了。怎么回事？

next_lines.text: I caused it. I shipped a migration without a dry run, and it locked the orders table for 20 minutes.
next_lines.translation: 是我造成的。我发了一个没有预演的迁移，把订单表锁了 20 分钟。

next_lines.text: It was my change. The config I pushed pointed staging traffic at the production queue.
next_lines.translation: 是我的改动。我推的配置把预发流量指到了生产队列。

line.text: How bad was it? Did we lose any data?

next_lines.text: No data loss — I rolled back within 20 minutes. About 300 orders were delayed, and I've already messaged the three affected customers.
next_lines.translation: 没有丢数据——我 20 分钟内回滚了。大约 300 笔订单延迟，我已经联系了受影响的三个客户。

next_lines.text: Data is intact. The damage is that two teams lost half a day waiting on us, and I've told both of them directly.
next_lines.translation: 数据完好。损失是两个团队白等了半天，我已经直接跟他们说了。

line.text: Okay. So what stops this from happening again?
line.translation: 好。那怎么保证不再发生？

next_lines.text: Two things. I've added a dry-run gate to the migration pipeline, and I'm writing up the incident so the next person doesn't repeat it.
next_lines.translation: 两件事。我给迁移流水线加了预演卡点，另外在写事故复盘，免得下一个人重蹈覆辙。

next_lines.text: Short term I'm reviewing every migration myself for a month. Longer term I want a staging check in CI, but that needs your sign-off.
next_lines.translation: 短期我自己 review 所有迁移，先做一个月。长期想在 CI 里加预发校验，但那需要你点头。

guidance: 你是他的主管，关心的是「信息是否完整」和「会不会再犯」，不是惩罚。用户含糊其辞（「出了点问题」）时，追问「具体是什么、影响多少人」；用户把责任推给别人或环境时，直接问「这个决定是谁做的」；用户只说抱歉不说处置时，问「你现在做了什么」。用户主动说清影响并给出措施时，明确表示认可，然后追问一个执行细节（时间点、谁来验）。不要一次问两个问题，也不要说教。
